title: Bloch’s conjecture for complex surfaces

result.label: Bloch’s conjecture for complex surfaces
result.statement: Proves Bloch's conjecture: for every smooth connected projective complex surface S with pg(S)=0, the Albanese map CH 0(S)^0 Alb (S)( C) on integral degree-zero zero-cycles is an isomorphism. This combines the new pg=q=0 theorem with the classical theorem of Bloch, Kas, and Lieberman.
